Description: Archbald is a historic Lackawanna Valley borough in northeastern Pennsylvania known for its rich anthracite coal mining heritage, peaceful small-town atmosphere, and major defense manufacturing anchor in Lockheed Martin Missiles and Fire Control. Situated just north of Scranton along the Lackawanna River, Archbald offers convenient access to regional healthcare at the Wilkes-Barre VA Medical Center, outdoor recreation in the Pocono foothills, and full PA state income tax exemption on military retirement pay.
